task.title: Fix CLI publish retry, bounded interactive confirmation, persistence error classification and concurrent same-ID send
task.description: Turn the RED tests from dispatch 001-T33-tests GREEN by implementing the four confirmed T28 review findings F-001, F-002, F-003 and F-008 in apps/cli, extending packages/session-node only where a required durable state transition is missing. The tests are the contract: make them pass without weakening them.
task.scope: apps/cli production code, plus packages/session-node ONLY for the explicit one-time-prekey rotation capability required by F-001. Do not modify apps/relay.

acceptance_criteria: F-001 (major): the exact signed publication bundle is persisted before the first network call and reused byte-identically across retries and process restarts, so a lost publish response can be recovered instead of colliding with the relay's permanent one-time-prekey uniqueness contract. Repeating an already successful publish resubmits the same bundle_id. Allocating a fresh bundle and a fresh one-time prekey happens only through the explicit, separate `rotateBundle()` operation on the outbound messenger.

F-002 (major): the interactive contact-import confirmation reads one bounded line and settles on the newline, on EOF without a newline, or on an overlong answer. It must not wait for stdin EOF after a completed line, and the process must not stay alive because stdin is still referenced - release/unref stdin as part of the fix.

F-003 (major): a typed persistence failure is introduced at the store boundary and preserved through the runtime and contact-import catch blocks, mapping to a redacted PERSISTENCE_FAILURE with exit 5. This must hold for the post-send delivery commit, the inbound poll/history commit and the contact-import commit. Typed validation, trust and native decrypt failures must still map to exit 3 - the control test asserting this must stay green, so the fix may not be achieved by widening exit 5.

F-008 (blocker): the CLI outbox is re-read and validated INSIDE the same transaction that encrypts and writes history. If the record already exists, the persisted record is returned without regenerating the envelope or appending history; the pre-transaction lookup remains only as an optimization. Two independent runtime/store instances sending the same message_id produce exactly one outbox envelope, one envelope_id and one history entry.
Every test added by 001-T33-tests passes, unmodified: outbound.publish.test.ts, cli.processFailures.test.ts, outbound.concurrentSend.test.ts.
The full apps/cli suite, the workspace suite (`pnpm test`) and `pnpm typecheck` pass, with no pre-existing test weakened, skipped or deleted.

Anti-vacuity check for F-008: after the suite is green, temporarily revert only the outbound in-transaction recheck, confirm outbound.concurrentSend.test.ts fails again, then restore the fix. Record that evidence. A concurrency test that passes because its barrier stopped firing is not evidence.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet/.metaproject/index.md before any repository action; project root is /Users/Goodea/goodea/projects/echolet.
Load and follow the project task-implementer skill (.metaproject/skills/gdskills/orchestration/task-implementer/SKILL.md).

ORCHESTRATOR DECISION on the test author's question Q1: option (a) is adopted. `rotateBundle()` on the outbound messenger is the intended public name, and adding an explicit one-time-prekey rotation capability to packages/session-node IS in scope for F-001. Rationale: the finding's own suggested fix requires fresh-OTK allocation as a separate explicit operation, the specification states a device may publish another independently signed bundle only with a newly generated one-time prekey, and the implementation plan permits extending packages/session-node when a required durable state transition is missing. Keep that extension minimal and additive; do not change existing session-node behaviour or its persisted record formats beyond what rotation requires.

You did not write these tests and you may not weaken them. Do not edit, skip, delete or relax any test file to make the suite pass. If a test is genuinely wrong, report it as a finding and return DONE_WITH_CONCERNS instead of changing it.

The F-008 test installs a test-only barrier on EncryptedSqliteStore.prototype.transaction, anchored to the semantic stale-read event. Your fix must keep that event observable - do not restructure the code so the barrier silently stops firing and the test passes vacuously. The anti-vacuity check in the acceptance criteria is mandatory.
You do not accept your own work. An independent verifier reviews it afterwards.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not modify apps/relay - a parallel worker owns that scope.
Use `keryx ctx rg` for searches, never bare rg/grep. Use `keryx ctx run` for long command output.

Never log or print plaintext message bodies, ciphertext, profile store keys, private key material or HTTP request bodies. The persisted publication bundle must not be rendered into diagnostics or reports.
Do not commit: this repository has an unborn untracked baseline, so partial root commits are forbidden.
Write a valid subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T33-implement-result.json and make the final response start with STATUS:.

Also write a short implementation report to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/t33-implementation-report.md describing the change per finding, the new persisted publication-bundle record, the typed persistence error boundary, and the session-node rotation addition.
